checks.note: Authentication page lists four OAuth2 flows (server-side, client-side, username/password, app auth), OAuth2 header, 8h access / 28d refresh tokens, client ID/secret required. OAuth2 is for third-party API access. 'Other' is not needed, since app auth is an OAuth flow.

API key page says get it via the API key tab in settings; it does not mention a paid plan or approval. A free tier (up to 5 users) appears only in a search snippet of the Progress pricing page, not a page I fetched in full. API terms not verified.

Developers home page says the API exposes all Podio functionality (broad supported) and mentions client libraries, webhooks and raising rate limits on request. It does not say REST and does not mention WebSocket. The push doc page is 410 Gone. Webhooks exist, but WebSocket is not confirmed. REST is the likely type, but not stated.

Progress-hosted Podio docs describe the Podio MCP Server at https://mcp.podio.com/mcp. It is in beta and uses OAuth 2.0. The page does not explicitly say Progress publishes it, but it sits on the vendor's docs site.
ready_with_caveats is consistent with the evidence: rate limits, MCP beta, and unverified API terms. The blocker text should drop 'WebSocket' as a stated type.

corrected.one_liner: Podio is a customizable work-management platform (now under Progress/ShareFile) where teams build apps, workspaces, tasks and workflows.
corrected.auth_notes: Four OAuth2 flows: server-side, client-side, username/password (discouraged), and app authentication (single app, no user). Requires a client ID/secret ("API key") from account settings. Header: `Authorization: OAuth2 ACCESS_TOKEN`. Access tokens last 8 hours, refresh tokens 28 days.
corrected.access_notes: An API key is generated from the API key tab in a Podio account's settings. The page mentions no approval or paid-plan requirement. A search snippet of the Progress pricing page indicates a free plan (up to 5 users), but I did not fetch it in full. API Terms of Use not verified. Rate limits apply and can be raised on request.
corrected.blocker: Rate limits apply and need a contact to raise. The official MCP server is in beta. The username/password flow is discouraged. API terms and free-plan status not confirmed from a fetched page. 'REST' is inferred, not stated. WebSocket was removed because no fetched page supports it; the push docs page returns 410.
